highlights: New native iPhone app with the same single-screen metronome, sounds, accents, time signatures, tap tempo, screen flash, and haptics
Shared Kotlin Multiplatform core: timing, delay compensation, click synthesis, settings, and app state are identical on Android and iPhone
iPhone background playback with Lock Screen / Control Center Now Playing controls
Calibration offsets (visual, vibration, Bluetooth) available on both platforms
New GitHub Actions workflow that tests the shared logic on the iOS simulator and builds an unsigned iPhone app package
